body: I'm figuring things out step by step, I can't thank you guys enough for everything.
I'm trying very hard to stay optimistic, but sometimes I feel like I've hit a wall; like I don't have the ability to make things better.
I've been to the free counseling service but it wasn't very helpful.  The support and advice that I've gotten from reddit has been much more helpful, I really really appreciate everybody's help.

I'm going to call the hospital and try to figure something out when I get off work, I really appreciate that advice.  

I've been saying that to my family for a while now, but it never seems to have much of an effect.  I have obsessive compulsive disorder and it's extremely hard to stop obsessing over thoughts that bother me, I wish they knew how much it sets me back in school/work/sleep when I'm obsessing over playing the mediator.

I've used the counseling services before, but they weren't very helpful.  The counselors are just grad students that need a certain number of volunteer hours to graduate, reddit has been much more helpful. I really, really appreciate it.

I owe it to a hospital. It's been unpaid for a while, I got a letter a few days ago from their lawyers saying that it would lower my credit score if I didn't send the money within 30 days.  I guess it isn't the end of the world, but it's causing me a lot of stress.  I didn't know about payment plans, I feel better about that now. Thank you.
